source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top parses
summary: Fireball spam with Scorch used to keep the Improved Scorch debuff at 5 stacks (if you're the assigned scorcher). Fire Blast on the move.

Frostbolt.note: Frost ability - wrong spec for a Fire mage; check spec/macros

advisory: Scorch is only for maintaining the 5-stack Improved Scorch debuff - beyond keeping it up, every Scorch should be a Fireball. Heavy Scorch counts can mean over-scorching. Fight notes: on movement-heavy fights (Vashj phase 2 kiting, Kael weapons, Shade of Aran), expect more Fire Blast and Scorch as your only on-the-move filler - don't read those as rotation errors. On add-heavy pulls (Karathress, Hyjal trash, Council), drop the single-target Fireball loop for Arcane Explosion or Flamestrike to maximize AoE throughput, while keeping the Scorch debuff parked on the boss/priority target.
